kdp_metadata.title: Kawaii Student Planner 2026 — Cotton Candy Edition
kdp_metadata.subtitle: 90-Page Academic Planner for High School & College with Weekly Spreads & Sticker Pages
kdp_metadata.author: OnBrandCraftz
kdp_metadata.description: Study smarter and plan cuter with the Kawaii Student Planner 2026 in the bright Cotton Candy theme (pink and sky blue). This 90-page academic planner covers every week of the school year with monthly calendars, 52 weekly layouts, habit tracker, goals page, notes pages, and a full kawaii sticker library. Designed for high school and college students who want their planner to be as fun as their life.

cover.cover_note: Cover file 'DP1027_kawaii_cover.jpg' not found. A separate full-bleed KDP cover PDF must be created using KDP Cover Creator or a compatible design tool. The spine width above is the critical measurement.
cover.cover_dimensions_note: Full bleed cover dimensions: (9.4842)" wide × 11.25" tall (includes 0.25" bleed on all sides)

pricing.pricing_note: KDP price set higher than Etsy to account for physical printing costs. Color interior printing cost included in royalty calculation. Recommend pricing $2-4 above Etsy price for comparable perceived value.

distribution.kdp_select_note: Do NOT enroll in KDP Select (Kindle Unlimited exclusivity). We sell the digital version on Etsy — exclusivity would block that.
distribution.expanded_distribution_note: Enable Expanded Distribution to reach bookstores and libraries. Royalty drops to 40% for expanded distribution sales.

checklist.task: Create KDP publisher account at kdp.amazon.com
checklist.notes: Use Printing3dthings@outlook.com. Need bank account and tax info (EIN or SSN).

checklist.task: Complete tax interview in KDP account
checklist.notes: Required before first royalty payment. US persons use SSN/EIN on W-9.
Use KDP Cover Creator (free, in KDP dashboard) or Canva/InDesign. Spine width: 0.4842" (12.3 mm). Include front cover + spine + back cover as one PDF.

checklist.task: Set up new paperback title in KDP
checklist.notes: KDP Dashboard → Create → Paperback. Fill in title, subtitle, author, description, keywords, categories. Select: Color interior, white paper, 8.5×11 trim size.
Upload the interior PDF. KDP will run automated checks and show a preview. Review every page in the online previewer before continuing.
Upload the cover PDF or use KDP Cover Creator. Ensure the spine text is readable and spine width matches calculation.
Set list price to $14.99. Enable Expanded Distribution. Do NOT enroll in KDP Select. Review royalty calculation in KDP dashboard before publishing.

KDP requires AI disclosure for AI-generated content (effective Jan 2024). In the KDP listing, check 'Yes' for AI-generated content. Add to book description: 'Cover art and interior design created with AI tools.'
KDP review takes 24-72 hours. You will receive an email when approved. The book will appear on Amazon within 72 hours of approval.

checklist.task: Add Amazon link to Etsy listing
checklist.notes: Once live on Amazon, add to Etsy listing description: 'Prefer a physical copy? Order the printed version on Amazon → [link]'. This adds perceived value without cannibalizing digital sales.

target_audience: High school and college students, back-to-school buyers
